_doc: One entry per edited shot, in timeline order. See references/edit-pipeline.md for every field. Same cuts and events as the Higgsfield edit; one take per line (lNN), heads at most 0.28 s.

cuts.note: 1 OWNER: Hey... I think we should break up.
2 AGENCY: You're breaking up... with your marketing agency? Shock punch-in.
3 OWNER: It's not you. It's your invoices. Slight push-in for the title line.
4 AGENCY: ...Wow. Tight, and hold the pout for 1.15 s.
5 AGENCY: Fine. But who's going to answer all your questions?
6 OWNER: I don't know... DING + banner 1; he flips the phone face down.
7 AGENCY: Who's going to reply to your reviews? 0.85 s head keeps her suspicious look before the line.
8 OWNER: No idea. DING + banner 2; he coughs.
9 AGENCY: Who's going to post on your Instagram?
10 OWNER: Not a clue. DING + banner 3; he whistles and looks away.
11 AGENCY: Who's going to get you to the top of Google Maps? Her last card.
12 OWNER: Honestly? Absolutely no idea. DING DING + banner 4; the smile breaks through.
13 AGENCY: Wait... are you seeing someone else? Squint, punch-in.
14 OWNER: What? ...What? No. Tightest punch-in of the video.
15 AGENCY: Then who keeps texting you?
16 OWNER: It's... just an app. He shows the phone.
17 AGENCY: You're leaving us... for an app?! Punch-in on the outrage.
18 OWNER: It replies at 2 a.m. You reply in five business days.
19 AGENCY: Fine. You'll come crawling back. Don't even think about calling me. 2.5 s tail so she turns and walks out; a 0.6 s cutaway to the owner's silent face from the end of take 18.
20 OWNER: What? Babe, no! Come back!
21 OWNER: silent celebration, DING at 2.85 s, then he says 'Hey, you.' to the phone.
